question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d249860be771b71095f378767287e089571d4216a82205115bdf0d2c3a3ec96a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: The number of vertical lines increases by one in each step, while the small square alternates its position and shading.**

Vertical lines: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5

Square position: Right → Left → Right → Left → Right

Square shading: Hollow → Shaded → Hollow → Shaded → Hollow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c496c2f1fc944c046d01bd8d8549e306ffa9c71265781da76ced5c0e227dfd.png] 

So, the next figure must contain: 5 vertical lines

A hollow square at the bottom-right corner

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
